paragraphs: Huna bar Geniva — Kohelet Rabbah, end of chapter 4.[^1]

notes.text: This is Hyman’s collective name index, with two separate lexical pointers. The named William Davidson Bava Batra 139a paragraph writes Abuha bar Geniva. The Kohelet Rabbah end-of-chapter-4 reference is retained as supplied and has not been freshly collated. The two fathers called Geniva are not thereby identified with one another; no target identity is assigned.
